evidence.name: Screen field: Vertical alignment of items
evidence.userNeed: Know what "Vertical alignment of items" controls and when to adjust it while editing a screen.

sections.title: Vertical alignment of items
sections.description: Aligns each choice's content to the top, center, or bottom of its cell. It's most noticeable in grid layouts where cells are taller than their content; center usually looks balanced. In simple lists it has little visible effect, so center is a safe default.
